paper_claim: Hybrid three-pillar fusion outperforms single-pillar baselines
evidence: P1+P2+P3 achieves AUROC 1.000 vs P1 alone 0.962 and P2 alone 0.824
limitation: Evaluated on factual scientific QA claims

paper_claim: Availability-aware adaptive fusion prevents score degradation when signals are missing
evidence: Mask [1 0 1] retains AUROC 0.991 vs Fixed fusion AUROC 0.842 (Cohen d=1.42)
limitation: Assumes at least one pillar signal remains available

paper_claim: Platt scaling probability calibration reduces ECE and Brier score without hurting ranking discrimination
evidence: ECE reduced from 0.197 to 0.094 (52.5% reduction) and Brier from 0.041 to 0.016
limitation: Platt parameters fitted on dev split only

paper_claim: Selective abstention achieves zero empirical error at 80% coverage on confident predictions
evidence: Selective error drops to 0.0% at 80% coverage with AURC=0.0051
limitation: Abstains on 20% of high-ambiguity or retrieval-deficit claims

paper_claim: HalluciSense generalizes across diverse scientific domains without domain-specific fine-tuning
evidence: Leave-one-domain-out AUROC ranges from 0.996 to 1.000 across 6 domains
limitation: Domains limited to natural and formal sciences

paper_claim: HalluciSense is portable across heterogeneous generator LLMs
evidence: Portability AUROC >= 0.996 across GPT-4 Claude Gemini and LLaMA-3
limitation: Evaluated on top contemporary frontier foundation models

paper_claim: Closed-loop atomic claim correction reduces hallucination without inducing new errors
evidence: CSR=89.8% RPR=92.5% and CIHR=1.6% (well below 3% tolerance)
